description: Apply the adapt proposal (draft): wire nav into the menu store and/or rewrite the blog index to a live <dotsy-collection>. One undo covers the whole apply; a second apply is refused until adapt_site_revert (or force). Queued applies are polled to completion.

dryRun.description: Full computation, would-write set + previews, ZERO writes, no undo.

force.description: An undo record from a prior apply exists (409 adapt_undo_exists): defer-discard it — the prior record is dropped only when this apply SUCCEEDS; a partial-failure rollback reinstates it. Prefer adapt revert first.

ifMatch.description: The proposal etag from analyze (or GET …/adapt/proposal / status).

name: adapt_site_apply
